notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639227/c9ba9d68e7681e5bdbd1143888db411bf5d193d8.png

Tristan’s journey to restore the twisted time and space through the Book of Stars begins now!

Greetings, Star Guardians.
This is .

Mark your calendars — pre-registration for  begins on Sunday, June 1st, across all platforms: console, PC, and mobile!

Visit the official brand site below to pre-register and explore a variety of content, including character introductions, worldbuilding details, and the release roadmap.

You can also add  to your wishlist on the Steam Store to receive the latest launch updates as soon as they’re available. We sincerely appreciate your interest and support!

For more information, please refer to the details below.

◈  Pre-Registration Details ◈

🔹 Pre-Registration Period
- June 1, 2025 (Sun) 20:05 (PDT) - Until the official launch

🔹 Official  Brand Site
▶ Go to the Official  Brand Site

🔸 Notes
- The pre-registration period is subject to change based on internal circumstances. Any changes will be announced through this notice.

We look forward to your interest and participation, Star Guardians!

Thank you.
